title: Code and analysis for "Aggregate Accuracy Conceals an Acquisition-Level Failure in a Public Radar Target Recognition Benchmark"
description:
Session-grouped evaluation of the Real Doppler RAD-DAR database. Twenty of twenty-one drone acquisitions reach out-of-fold recall between 0.90 and 0.99; one reaches 0.249. Held out of training entirely, recall on a held-back half is 0.157, rising to 0.967 once the other half is in training.

The repository contains the full pipeline (inventory and deduplication, acquisition grouping, the split comparison, the coverage experiment, the compression grid, the leave-one-acquisition-out test), sixteen unit tests of the claims the paper makes about the code, a synthetic self-test that runs the whole pipeline without the archive and without a GPU, and a verification script that reruns every experiment on the real archive and checks each number the paper states against a recorded tolerance.

The Real Doppler RAD-DAR database itself is not redistributed here. It is obtained separately from Kaggle.
